title: More Than Just a Realtor
seoTitle: More Than Just a Realtor in Surprise, AZ | Teigh Wade REALTOR®
description: Teigh Wade is a REALTOR® and much more: Licensed Massage Therapist, Licensed Insurance Producer, Reiki Master/Teacher, hypnotherapist and web designer.
summary: Beyond real estate, I'm a Licensed Massage Therapist, a Licensed Insurance Producer in Arizona, a Reiki Master/Teacher and a certified master practitioner in several wellness modalities. I offer hypnotherapy through EnerCHI, web design through Visibly Online and home staging. Each one shapes how I care for my real estate clients.

sections.h2: Why I'm more than just a Realtor
sections.html:
Real estate is my main focus. I'm Teigh Wade, a REALTOR® with HomeSmart Elite Group, HomeSmart, and I've wanted to work in real estate since the early 2000s. But I've never been a one-lane person. Over the years I've earned licenses and certifications in fields that all come back to the same thing: taking care of people.

As I like to put it, "“Getting The Sale” is NOT my mission. Helping people navigate through every process of Real Estate is." Everything on this page is part of how I do that. With me, you get THE Real T!

I'm a Licensed Massage Therapist. That training taught me to listen closely, pay attention to how people are really doing and respect their comfort. Buying or selling a home can be a lot, and I bring that same attentiveness to every showing, every negotiation and every closing.

I'm a Licensed Insurance Producer in Arizona. Insurance comes up in almost every home purchase, and my background helps me understand the questions my clients are asking. If you'd like to talk about insurance, call me and we'll see how I can help.

I'm a Reiki Master/Teacher and a certified master practitioner in several wellness modalities. This work is a big part of who I am. For my real estate clients, it shows up as patience, calm and a steady presence when a transaction gets busy.
I offer hypnotherapy through EnerCHI. You can learn more on the EnerCHI site or call 833-EnerCHI (833-363-7244).
I design websites through Visibly Online. If you're a small business owner who wants to be easier to find online, call me at 480-550-2871 and let's talk about what you need.

Staging is where my eye for detail meets real estate. I offer staging consultations with a room-by-room plan, hands-on staging with your own furniture and decor, and full staging with my own furniture and decor, including vacant homes. Staging help is included when you list with me. See my home staging page for details.

sections.h2: How it all comes back to real estate
sections.html:
Every one of these roles has made me a better REALTOR®. I listen first. I notice when someone is overwhelmed. I'm comfortable with paperwork, and as a notary public and loan signing agent I know how closing documents work. I can help a home look its best and help a small business get seen. And I'm also a certified wedding officiant, because some of the people I meet are starting a whole new chapter.

Ready to talk about buying or selling? Call or text me at 480-550-2871, or start on my selling or buying pages. You can also read more about me.

faqs.q: Why does a REALTOR® also have massage, insurance and wellness credentials?
faqs.a: Because all of my work comes back to caring for people. I'm a Licensed Massage Therapist, a Licensed Insurance Producer in Arizona and a Reiki Master/Teacher, and each one taught me to listen closely and stay steady when things get busy. Real estate is my main focus, and those skills make me a better REALTOR® for my buyers and sellers.

Yes. I offer hypnotherapy through EnerCHI. You can learn more on the EnerCHI website at enerchi.me or call 833-EnerCHI (833-363-7244). It's separate from my real estate work, so you never need to be a real estate client to book with EnerCHI, and you never need to book with EnerCHI to work with me as your REALTOR®.

faqs.q: Can you build a website for my business?
faqs.a: Yes. I design websites through Visibly Online. If you're a small business owner who wants a site that helps people find you and understand what you do, call me at 480-550-2871. We'll talk about your business, what you need the site to do and the next steps, and I'll give you a quote.

Yes. I offer staging consultations with a room-by-room plan, hands-on staging with your own furniture and decor, and full staging with my own furniture and decor, including vacant homes. Staging help is included when you list your home with me. For staging-only projects, call me at 480-550-2871 for rates, or visit my home staging page.

faqs.q: Do I have to use your other services to work with you as a REALTOR®?
faqs.a: No. Real estate is my main focus, and you can hire me as your listing agent or buyer's agent without using any of my other services. They're simply part of who I am and how I care for people. If one of them would help you along the way, I'll mention it, and the choice is always yours.
